chunks.label: Architecture — request cycle
chunks.text: A real request, end to end. The exact path a request takes through the Rutgers tutoring platform I built and run. Click a node for details, or send one and watch. Client UI (Next.js dashboard) → Auth + isolation (middleware guard) → Service layer (Next.js server logic) → PostgreSQL (scoped query).

chunks.label: Vision playground
chunks.text: Live object detection in the browser: a YOLOS transformer (ONNX) runs on-device over your webcam feed and draws labeled boxes in real time. No video ever leaves your device.

chunks.label: Lab — embedding map
chunks.text: The search's brain, visualized: every content chunk on this site embedded into vector space and flattened to a 2D PCA map. Type a query and watch it land near its nearest semantic neighbors.

chunks.label: Lab — rate limiter
chunks.text: A live token-bucket rate limiter and queue simulator — tune arrival rate, bucket size, and refill rate, then watch requests deliver, queue, or drop. Built from the SoftScribble messaging pipeline work that cut failed sends 38%.

chunks.label: Synth panel
chunks.text: Every UI sound on this site is synthesized live with the Web Audio API — no audio files anywhere. The Lab's synth panel plays the actual interface sounds and bends their pitch and decay, with a live oscilloscope of the waveform.
